question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS accumulated_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT pr2.contains_id FROM packaging_relations pr2)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty,
        pr.contains_id
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = h.current_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        leaf_id,
        SUM(accumulated_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    GROUP BY top_id, leaf_id
)
SELECT 
    tp.name AS top_level_container,
    lp.name AS item_name,
    CAST(t.total_qty AS INTEGER) AS total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging tp ON tp.id = t.top_id
JOIN packaging lp ON lp.id = t.leaf_id
WHERE t.total_qty > 500
ORDER BY tp.name, lp.name
